title: Affine slope-policy invariance of the accepted real-SWAP/MODFLOW solution

common_initial_affine_point.rule: Every variant passes through the production predictor point (H_ref,q_ref) before the first MODFLOW solve.

slope_policies.name: INTERCEPT_ONLY
slope_policies.hcof_rule: zero retained slope; reanchor only the intercept after each real corrector

iteration_contract: Solve one MODFLOW prepared-solve iteration with the current affine term.
Run the unchanged real F-GC45 SWAP corrector at the returned head.
If not jointly converged, discard the SWAP candidate and reanchor only RHS so the same variant slope passes through the measured (H,q_swap) pair.
On joint convergence, finalize MODFLOW once, publish the accepted SWAP candidates once, then publish each ledger once.
gates: all three variants converge within the unchanged F-GC45 iteration budget
the CURRENT_PLUS_U result reproduces the admitted F-GC45 final head within 1e-10 m
pairwise final accepted head spread across policies <=1e-10 m
pairwise final real corrector flux spread across policies <=1e-15 m/s
each variant closes its coupled residual <=1e-15 m/s
each variant's tile ledgers equal area_fraction*q_tile*duration_s within 1e-12 m
pairwise total accepted ledger spread across policies <=1e-14 m
each variant commits exactly one SWAP candidate and one ledger entry per tile
characterization_only: number of coupling iterations per policy
interpretation_rules: If final physical state and ledgers are invariant while paths differ, classify slope as iteration policy rather than published physical mass.
If a slope policy changes the accepted physical state beyond the fixed gates, do not dismiss that as solver behavior; treat it as a coupling-algorithm dependency.
Do not rank policies by speed from this single very-short-window fixture.
Do not change production F-GC33/F-GC40/F-GC49D from MAP04 alone.
forbidden: no retuning of the local-corrector slope
